start: A 90-second rest running on the watch, the "Rest" card counting down on the watch face

steps.action: Restart the watch 30 seconds into the rest
user_sees: After start-up the watch face shows "Rest" counting down from the time really left
must_not: The countdown starts again from 90 seconds
No countdown and no alarm after the restart

steps.action: Wait for the rest to end
user_sees: One buzz and the "Rest is over" card at the rest's end
must_not: Two buzzes
No buzz

start: A rest running; the watch app updates from Play mid-rest

steps.action: Let the update install, then wait for the rest to end
user_sees: The countdown card back after the update
One buzz at the rest's end
must_not: The alarm lost by the update, so no buzz
A crash on the first start of the new version

start: A rest running; the watch's "Alarms & reminders" was off, so the end alarm was inexact

steps.action: Open "Open settings" from the app and turn on "Alarms & reminders"
user_sees: The rest's alarm is set again, now on the second
must_not: A second alarm, so two buzzes
The rest ending early

start: A 60-second rest running; the watch restarts and takes 2 minutes to come back

steps.action: Wait for the watch to start
user_sees: No buzz and no card: the lost rest is dropped quietly
must_not: A late buzz in the middle of the next set
A countdown stuck at 0:00

start: A rest that ends while the watch app is being updated (it ends 2 seconds before the app starts again)

steps.action: Wait after the update
user_sees: Either a buzz and "Rest is over", or the rest cleared
must_not: A rest that stays saved as running with no alarm and no card (neither restored nor dropped)
A buzz only much later, when the app is opened

start: The watch finishes starting up with a rest saved that ends in 40 seconds

steps.action: The start-up signal reaches the watch app
user_sees: The rest's alarm set again for the same end time
The countdown card shown again
The phone's alert copy settings applied again
This app's version written for the phone
must_not: The rest's end time changed
A buzz at start-up

start: The watch starts up with no rest saved

steps.action: The start-up signal reaches the watch app
user_sees: Nothing about rests changes
must_not: A countdown or a buzz with no rest
An alarm set for time zero

start: The rest was skipped on the phone just before the watch restarted

steps.action: The watch starts up
user_sees: No rest is restored (the skip already cleared it)
must_not: The skipped rest coming back

steps.action: The "Alarms & reminders" switch changes later
user_sees: Nothing is set again; no app version is written for this signal
must_not: A rest alarm with no rest

start: A 90-second rest running on the watch, the "Rest" card counting down on the watch face

steps.action: Restart the watch 30 seconds into the rest
user_sees: After start-up the watch face shows "Rest" counting down from the time really left
must_not: The countdown starts again from 90 seconds
No countdown and no alarm after the restart

steps.action: On the old version, do "A running rest keeps its alarm and countdown after the watch restarts, the app u" up to step 1; update the app; open it and carry on.
user_sees: The journey carries on or starts again cleanly, with nothing lost that was saved
must_not: A crash on first open, a lost or half-saved saved data, or a step that the new version no longer understands

note: an update mid-rest is this feature's own case

must_not: The countdown starts again from 90 seconds
No countdown and no alarm after the restart

steps.action: Do step 1 of "A running rest keeps its alarm and countdown after the watch restarts, the app u" on the phone with the watch connected; look at both. Then do it from the watch.
user_sees: Phone and watch show the same saved data within a few seconds
must_not: Two different values on phone and watch, a double saved data made by both, or the watch stuck on the old state

note: the phone skips or changes the rest while the watch restarts

steps.action: Turn the internet off at step 1 of "A running rest keeps its alarm and countdown after the watch restarts, the app u", carry on, then turn it back on.

must_not: A lost saved data, a double saved data after the retry, or a success message for a save that failed

note: the phone out of range during the restart: the rest comes from the watch's own storage
